# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.27 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.26. Written and tested by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; **nothing was tried on Windows, macOS or arm64**.

**New**
- **"All options…" window**: every command-line option (200+) in the window, grouped by topic (pages and order; straighten, crop, clean; output; OCR and text; archiving, signing, verification; search and compare; batches and system), searchable by name or description, with file/folder pickers, a copyable equivalent command and a **Run** button with live output and **Stop**. The window's pages and settings go to the command as a temporary project. The list is read from the `legatorocr` program shipped next to the window (`legatorocr --dump-options`), so it matches the build. Option descriptions stay in English.
- **Help → User guide**: opens the always-current online guide (legatorocr.chiuta.ro/Ghid-LegatorOCR.pdf) and, when the PDF sits next to the program (it is now inside every archive), the copy of this edition.
- The guide PDF is rebuilt for this edition (new section with screenshots of the window); its source is in `docs/guide-src/`, and a release is refused when the guide does not name its version.
- The macOS app now carries the command-line program and the guide inside the bundle (the window needs the former for "All options").

**Verified**: unit tests for the option list parser, categories, argument building and search; a CLI test of `--dump-options`; the window opened under a virtual display, searched, ran `--duplex-adf --dry-run` with six pages and showed the output.
**Not verified**: Windows, macOS, arm64; file/folder pickers of the window; opening the guide in a real browser; the new window texts are machine-written translations; Run with options that need a long time or special modules (only a dry run was tried).

**Known limits (unchanged)**: OCR can misread characters such as `@`; a table without ruled lines is found as two tables; the display title of a page with a halftone panel is lost; the rotation behaviour seen on Windows 11 is unconfirmed.
